name: FLAG-IDA (salvage: Fludarabine / Cytarabine / Idarubicin + G-CSF)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: G-CSF (filgrastim) 5 mcg/kg/day SC from the day before chemotherapy through count recovery (the 'G' of FLAG, priming and support).
Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
Tumor-lysis prophylaxis: hydration and allopurinol (or rasburicase if high risk); monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.
LVEF for the anthracycline; track cumulative anthracycline exposure.
Renal and hepatic panels; neurologic checks with high-dose cytarabine.

drugs.name: Fludarabine
drugs.notes: 30 mg/m2 IV on days 1-5, given ahead of cytarabine to potentiate ara-C triphosphate accumulation (FLAG backbone). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Cytarabine (high-dose)
drugs.notes: 2000 mg/m2 IV over ~4 h on days 1-5, starting a few hours after fludarabine. Reduce for age/renal impairment. Corticosteroid eye drops for conjunctivitis prophylaxis. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Idarubicin
drugs.notes: 10 mg/m2 IV on days 1-3 (the 'IDA' of FLAG-IDA); omit for a G-CSF-priming-only FLAG in patients with cardiac limitation. Track cumulative anthracycline exposure. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
